cases.source: DeepAnalyze Stage-1 single-ability: structured data understanding

turns.message: Using the registered dataset test_x.csv: WITHOUT doing any further computation, call profile_dataset() and summarize: how many rows/columns, list column names, which columns have missing values, and how many duplicated rows exist. Keep it to a short bullet list.

Using the registered dataset gapminder_gdp_asia.csv: Write and execute code that computes the Pearson correlation between gdpPercap_1982 and gdpPercap_2007 across countries, rounded to 3 decimals. End with a line like: correlation=<value>

Using the registered dataset ravenna_250715.csv: Follow the 5-phase loop. 1) Analyze: state your plan in one sentence. 2) Understand: call profile_dataset() first. 3) Code+Execute: compute mean, median, std of the temp column, and the Pearson correlation between temp and humidity if both columns exist. 4) Answer: structured report with headings (Plan, Understanding, Results, Limitations) and end with mean_temperature=<value> to two decimals. Mention one limitation and one next check.
